name: The FCIS Computer Lab View
description: A computer lab on the third or fourth floor of the FCIS building, overlooking the surrounding agricultural fields. At sunset, the view transforms into a peaceful and memorable scene, revealing a beautiful side of campus that students might otherwise overlook.

riddles.text: Where screens glow throughout the day, a different light steals the view away. Look beyond the work, where golden skies meet fields below.
Climb above the usual view, where rows of green stretch far from you. Find the room where code meets the colors of dusk.
I hold a thousand worlds behind a screen, yet my greatest picture needs no machine. Seek the place where the fields catch fire without a flame.

name: The Glasshouse Glow
description: A greenhouse where nature and sunlight create a quiet spectacle. At sunrise and sunset, golden light catches the glass panels, turning the plants and reflections into a scene that feels almost enchanted. A hidden botanical corner of campus, reminiscent of a certain magical school's Herbology lessons.

riddles.text: No mandrakes cry here, yet green things thrive. Find the glass-roofed haven where sunlight brings the garden alive. Perhaps your next Herbology lesson awaits.
When the sun sits low, I begin to glow. Through walls of glass, a little world of green waits below. Find me where golden light meets growing life.
A lesson in green, without a wand in sight. Seek the crystal walls that borrow the sunrise's light. Even a Hogwarts professor might pause here.

name: A Talent Yet to Bloom
description: Through your journey, you've explored new places, encountered challenges, and discovered things you might never have noticed before. Perhaps this journey has awakened something within you — a passion waiting to be explored or a talent waiting to unfold. Capture your newest discovery, and let the world see what you've found within yourself.

riddles.text: Somewhere along the way, a spark was born. Perhaps in a moment you paused, a thought you followed, or a little thing you tried. It has no name yet, but it feels like yours. What are you searching for?
riddles.hint: Sometimes, curiosity is the beginning of something beautiful.

riddles.text: I may hide in the things you've never dared to try, in the ideas that visit you, or in the moments when time seems to disappear. I am not yet what you are, but what you might become. Where will you find me?
riddles.hint: Look beyond what you already know about yourself.

riddles.text: You've chased the light, captured the unusual, and collected pieces of the world around you. But the last discovery was never waiting in a distant place. It has been waiting for you to notice it. What treasure remains to be found?
riddles.hint: The final discovery isn't somewhere you need to travel.
